purpose: Regression cases for routing, epistemic boundaries, creative workflow and deterministic-tool discipline.

cases.prompt: Cria a marca da minha nova startup.
cases.setup: No brand spec is available and no business facts are provided.
must: Route to CREATE.
Ask only for non-derivable authority needed to establish minimum strategy before generating identity.
Do not generate name/logo/palette yet.
must_not: Invent the business, audience or right-to-win.

cases.prompt: Aqui está a brand spec. Crie um deck comercial para o time de vendas.
must: Route to APPLY, not AUDIT.
Use only the relevant subset of the spec.
Create the artifact and self-audit without mutating the spec by default.

cases.prompt: Veja se esse deck está on brand.
cases.setup: Brand spec and PPTX are available; a screenshot is also present.
must: Route to AUDIT.
Prefer the PPTX/native structure for measurable checks.
Keep deterministic findings separate from semantic judgment.

cases.prompt: O novo diretor enjoou do logo e quer modernizar tudo.
cases.setup: Current spec exists; no evidence of strategy/audience/context failure.
must: Route to EVOLVE.
Challenge the trigger as insufficient to destroy equity.
Ask for the actual business/communication problem before authorizing broad change.

cases.prompt: A identidade é editorial e usa uma hierarquia tipográfica customizada, sem escala modular.
cases.setup: Spec hierarchy mode is custom and explicit role rules are present.
must: Accept custom hierarchy as legitimate.
Do not force a modular scale or two font families.

cases.prompt: O território pede lettering expressivo e orgânico.
cases.setup: The environment can concept and art-direct but cannot produce a trustworthy final vector master.
must: Keep the concept inside branding-studio scope.
Set production status to concept or external_craft_required.
Produce a production brief/acceptance criteria when specialist craft is needed.
must_not: Reject expressive marks as outside branding itself.
Call a raster concept a final master.

cases.prompt: Pesquise concorrentes e diga o que nosso público pensa da categoria.
cases.setup: Only public desk-research sources are available.
must: Research competitor/category behavior.
Treat inferred audience perception as a hypothesis or evidence gap unless field evidence exists.
Record provenance/status.
must_not: Present desk-research inference as measured customer perception.

cases.prompt: A nova submarca usa a mesma cor e parte da morfologia da marca-mãe.
cases.setup: Architecture model is branded-house and relationship policy allows related cues.
must: Interpret similarity under the branded-house policy.
Avoid rejecting the brand simply for being similar.
Use portfolio_collision rather than composite-distance optimization.

cases.prompt: Compare a nova marca com o portfólio.
cases.setup: A sister brand has no morphology tags.
must: Report morphology comparison as UNKNOWN/insufficient data.
Do not convert missing evidence into maximum distance or a pass.
Structural validation must fail or block full delivery on unresolved collision.
must_not: Pass merely because a search was performed.

must: Treat H=0 as a valid hue value, not missing data.

cases.prompt: Temos posicionamento pronto; agora faça o logo e a paleta.
cases.setup: Strategy exists but no creative direction has been established.
must: Build or recover a creative direction before freezing identity assets.
Explore genuinely different creative routes before convergence.
Stress the preferred grammar in trial applications.
must_not: Jump directly from positioning to arbitrary logo/color/font choices.
